Structural aneurysmal disease of coronary vessels; inflammatory causes do not establish an immune mechanism across this group.
Inherited steroid metabolism disorders; adrenal, hepatic and vascular damage varies across subtypes and is not universal to the umbrella.
A molecular subtype of medulloblastoma, a primary cerebellar/CNS malignancy.

Retinal vascular development disorder causing retinal scarring and detachment; localized retinal vessels do not establish systemic cardiovascular disease.

Adenosquamous carcinoma originating in the colon; no common direct involvement of another organ is established.
Congenital hypomyelinating neuropathy; clubfoot and toe syndactyly each reported in 1/3. Respiratory failure reflects neuromuscular dysfunction, not direct lung damage.

Carcinoma originates in gallbladder or extrahepatic biliary epithelium, both hepatic; adjacent-organ invasion has no established frequency above 30%.

Congenital alveolar maldevelopment defines disease; broad cardiogenetic ancestry does not establish a specific cardiac lesion or common direct vascular damage.
Ultraviolet injury directly affects skin; inflammation from physical injury does not by itself establish an immune-mediated disease.

Myopathy with defining ptosis 24/24 and ophthalmoplegia 14/20; dysphagia 17/22 reflects pharyngeal muscle disease, without established direct gastrointestinal injury.
Chronic inflammatory polyarthritis of childhood directly affects joints and is immune-mediated; extra-articular damage is not established across the group.
Multiple skin webs, contractures and skeletal malformations define syndrome; pulmonary hypoplasia is common (>30%) in the lethal phenotype. Other defects are variable.
Ectodermal dysplasia defined by abnormal hair and nails, dental dysplasia and syndactyly; teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
